description: MacArthur Bridge → Wooded Canals (Nashua Canal) → Blue Heron Lagoon. Visual quality review, not a racing route or guided autopilot.

stops.name: MacArthur Bridge
stops.focus: Weathered arch concrete, steel rails, embankment stone and sun-facing structure

stops.name: Wooded Canals · Nashua Canal
stops.focus: Flatwoods canopy, exposed roots, shaded narrow lagoon, natural stones and clear trail margins

stops.name: Blue Heron Lagoon
stops.focus: Restored wetland edge, reeds, limestone riprap, lagoon mud, fallen wood and inlet footbridge
